Name: ⭐ Foul Breeze
Notes: Street's Disciple era throwaway. This song is mentioned by name in a Pound Magazine article from 2004 with bars heard written down. Another piece of evidence dating this song is Nas mentioning him being engaged to Kelis, which happened in 2004. It is mistaken that this song uses the "New York Shit" beat by Busta Rhymes however this is not true. They share the same sample but the usage is different. The second verse was partly reused for a Funkmaster Flex freestyle in 2005, with Nas saying "married" instead of "engaged" due to him marrying Kelis in Janurary of that year. He also used parts of verse 1 and 2 in his Rap City Freestyle (unknown what year it is from but likely 2006) which used the "New York Shit" beat by Busta Rhymes. Lastly, he reused verse 2 for the New York Shit Remix by Busta Rhymes. New York Shit and Foul Breeze sharing the same sample is pure coincidence and is likely what made Nas reuse bars for the Rap City Freestyle and the New York Shit remix.
